'''Nik''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who traveled aboard the ''[[Nova's Heart]]'' with [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] and her crew in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. Nik served as the cargo master's assistant ([[Yanus Melikan]]). He was completing his schooling while traveling on the ''Nova's Heart'' and was known to leave work at the last minute, and ended up completing assignments late into the night.
